requirement.description: The URL.build() method has incorrect validation logic for port parameter, causing TypeError when port is passed as a string instead of integer
requirement.contract: The build() method should properly validate that port is an integer when provided, raising TypeError with clear message when it's not an integer, and should also validate that port is not provided without host

requirement.description: The __setstate__ method for pickle deserialization doesn't properly handle the default style pickle format, leading to AttributeError during unpickling
requirement.contract: The __setstate__ method should correctly handle both the new and legacy pickle formats, ensuring compatibility with existing pickled objects

requirement.description: The URL.build() method doesn't properly validate that host is not None, causing issues with URL construction when host parameter is explicitly passed as None
requirement.contract: The build() method should validate that host, scheme, authority, path, query_string, and fragment are not None and raise TypeError with appropriate message when they are

requirement.description: The normalize_path function has incomplete implementation for handling trailing slashes and absolute paths correctly
requirement.contract: The normalize_path function should correctly handle absolute paths and preserve trailing slash semantics when normalizing path segments

requirement.description: The URL.build() method lacks proper validation for port parameter when it's not None but not an integer
requirement.contract: The build() method should validate that when port is provided, it must be an integer type, raising TypeError with descriptive message if not
